Modules

Source: R/modules.R
zl-modules.Rd

Each constructor declares its parameters in the store p, under names that start with name, and returns a function of tensors to use inside build() (see zl_graph()). Tensors have the feature dimension first: a batch of sequences is c(dim, n, batch).

Usage

zl_linear(p, name, n_in, n_out, bias = TRUE)

zl_embedding(p, name, n, dim)

zl_norm(p, name, dim, type = c("layer", "rms"), affine = TRUE, eps = 1e-05)

zl_attention(p, name, dim, heads = 1L, causal = TRUE)

zl_mlp(p, name, dim, hidden = 4 * dim, act = c("swiglu", "silu"))

zl_block(p, name, dim, heads, causal = TRUE, hidden = 4 * dim)

zl_adaln(p, name, dim, cond_dim)

zl_time_embedding(t, dim, max_period = 10000)

Arguments

p

A parameter store.

name

The prefix of the parameters' names.

n_in, n_out

Input and output widths.

bias

Whether to add a bias.

n

The number of rows of an embedding table.

dim

The feature width.

type

"layer" or "rms".

affine

Whether a normalisation has a learnt scale (and shift).

eps

Added to the variance, a positive number.

heads

The number of attention heads; must divide dim.

causal

Whether position i attends only to positions up to i.

hidden

The MLP's inner width.

act

"swiglu" or "silu".

cond_dim

The width of the conditioning tensor.

t

A tensor of times, of dims c(1, ...).

max_period

The longest period of the embedding.

Value

A function of tensors, except zl_time_embedding(), which returns a tensor.

Details

  • zl_linear(): zl_crossprod(weight, x) + bias, with weight of dims c(n_in, n_out); parameters <name>.weight and <name>.bias, initialised uniformly on (-1, 1) / sqrt(n_in) as in PyTorch.

  • zl_embedding(): rows of <name>.weight, of dims c(dim, n), for integer indices counting from 0 (an input declared with zl_int()); the result has dims c(dim, dim(idx)). Initialised as N(0, 1).

  • zl_norm(): layer or RMS normalisation of each column, then, with affine = TRUE, a scale <name>.weight (ones) and, for layer normalisation, a shift <name>.bias (zeros).

  • zl_attention(): multi-head self-attention with linear projections <name>.q, .k, .v and .o, scaled by 1 / sqrt(dim / heads), causal by default.

  • zl_mlp(): down(swiglu(gate(x), up(x))), or down(silu(up(x))) with act = "silu", with linears <name>.gate, .up and .down.

  • zl_block(): a pre-norm transformer block, h = x + attn(norm1(x)), then h + mlp(norm2(h)), with layer norms.

  • zl_adaln(): adaptive layer normalisation's modulation, function(x, cond) x * (1 + scale(cond)) + shift(cond), with linears <name>.scale and <name>.shift from cond_dim to dim.

  • zl_time_embedding(): no parameters; the sinusoidal embedding of times t of dims c(1, ...): cos(t f) then sin(t f) for the dim / 2 frequencies f_k = max_period^(-k / (dim / 2)).

Examples

p <- zl_params()
emb <- zl_linear(p, "in", n_in = 3, n_out = 8)
blk <- zl_block(p, "b1", dim = 8, heads = 2)
g <- zl_graph(function(x) blk(emb(x$x)), p, inputs = list(x = c(3, 5, 2)))
dim(zl_forward(g, list(x = array(0.1, c(3, 5, 2))))$output)
#> [1] 8 5 2
